system.description:
Lore: Relic Wand (Bound)

Duergar looted it from a drow caravan and never worked out how to stop it sticking to things. It has the following Powers:

  • Webbing: Holds 3 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Expend a charge to fill a Near Cube with thick webbing: it is Difficult Terrain, and a Being that enters it or starts its Turn in it must pass [Reflex] or be Restrained.
  • Entangle: A Being Restrained by the webs is Vulnerable until it breaks free.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
